question: At what temporal point is a particular event said to occur in relation to the fall of the body?
premises: A time is marked as the fall of the body.
At that time, the skull is broken.
The temporal correlative fixes that event to that moment.
inference: When the body falls, O goddess, the skull is broken at that time.
uncertainties: The ritual or doctrinal significance of the skull breaking is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: When, O goddess, the body falls and the skull is broken, then it is so.
